result:
`GET /admin/posts` is now registered (behind the `auth` middleware alias), alongside all the previously existing routes unchanged.

The `routes/admin.ts` file defining `registerAdminRoutes` (and its `admin.posts.index` → `AdminPostController.index`) already existed but was never invoked from `routes/web.ts`, so the route was never mounted — hence the 404 for everyone, including guests (who should have hit the `auth` middleware redirect instead). Fixed by importing and calling `registerAdminRoutes(router)` in `routes/web.ts`, using the same `router` instance that already carries the `'auth'` alias needed by `admin.ts`. Regenerated codegen manifests (`bunx guren codegen`) to pick up the newly named route, and verified with `bunx guren check` (confirms `routes/admin.ts`'s registrar is now wired), `bun run typecheck`, and `bun test` — all passing, with no other routes affected.
